messages:
Avery (CEO): Quick runtime follow-up from today's all-hands — batching, caching, kernels. Drop questions here; we'll capture action items.

Maya (Eng Manager): Can we get a one-liner on what lands next sprint vs research?

Rohit (VP Eng): Next sprint: KV cache bugfix + safer batching tweak + monitoring. Research: attention fusion & new matmul paths.

Jon (Runtime): KV bugfix PR rw-kv-271 is in review. Canary planned next week. The batching tweak is low-risk; it reduces micro-queueing for medium payloads.

Linh (ML Infra): Attention-fusion prototype shows ~12% long-seq gain in lab, but it needs more GPU matrix stress testing. R&D for now.

Camille (Product): Hosted vs Dedicated behavior?

Rohit (VP Eng): Hosted: staged rollout + automatic fallback. Dedicated: opt-in beta with SE assistance. No forced changes.

Jon (Runtime): Heads-up: enabling a longer batch window can increase tail for tiny, bursty calls. Mitigation: keep small-request heuristic (requests <32 tokens) to short-window path.

Maya (Eng Manager): Ops path: canary -> 24h monitor -> staged rollout -> fallback. Watch p50/p95 token latency and error rate.

Rohit (VP Eng): Timeline bullets: KV canary next week, batching safe rollout in 2 sprints, attention fusion prototype this quarter.

Jon (Runtime): Dev snippet for folks testing locally (dev-only):

```
./serve --kv-cache=on --batch-window-ms=8 --small-request-heuristic=on
```

Jon (Runtime): Don't flip these in hosted prod.

Camille (Product): Can SEs opt Dedicated customers into attention fusion early?

Rohit (VP Eng): Yes, on a vetted beta basis with Runtime sign-off.

deploy-bot: Canary started for rw-kv-271 on us-west-2-canary. CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/10011

Maya (Eng Manager): Watching canary metrics. Ping me if p95 > 180ms.

Jon (Runtime): Early canary: p50 -6%, p95 stable. Will post update in 6h.

Avery (CEO): Thanks all — closing thread in 24h unless more questions. Move open items to the runtime roadmap epic. :tada:
